verdict.rationale: Phaser ships a hosted Game Agent where you type what game you want, and an official MCP server whose docs say 'You describe what you want in plain language and your agent calls the tools for you.' The docs give concrete natural-language examples such as 'make gravity stronger' and 'Create a particle emitter, reorganise a scene into layers'. A runtime probe confirms the official MCP rides the hosted Game Agent, but no npm MCP package exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language control works well, and documentation of the 40+ tools' scope and limits.
